name: Blyushko
desc: The owner of Sadov-Arbat, a well respected establishment famous throughout Snezhnaya that even receives orders from the palace. Rather than prioritizing being an approachable salesman at the risk of damaging goods, he instead prides himself on his business wares for both their beauty and fragility.

customize.text:
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> If you need anything, come in, and we'll talk... But allow me to warn you that anything you break will be considered sold.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Let's see what you've got here...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> Sorry, but we're still taking inventory of newly arrived goods and need some time to reorganize items on our shelves. Please, do come back at a later date.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Are your goods expensive?</color>
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> Mostly not... but just as even sand can stack up into a tall tower, small losses can be harbingers for bankruptcy.
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> And most artworks are fragile things. Beautiful, yes, but fragile. If you have respect for their beauty, then do have a care.
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: Surely nothing's deliberately made to be fragile...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> This is Sadov-Arbat, a venerable and respected establishment famous throughout Snezhnaya. We even get orders from dedicated personnel at the palace.
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> You won't find any of the charlatanry those gangs are so fond of here!
<color=#ffffff>Traveler: We'll leave you be, then...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Blyushko:</color> We look forward to your future patronage... if there will indeed be a next time.
